design: 16 input-only evenly spaced exact-n/distribution/capacity cells; 64 rows/cell; first 32 fit and remaining 32 held within frozen TRAIN; no tuning/repeats
target: 100*(FP64 method_cost / per-instance legal-pool mean_cost - 1); all methods
baseline: fit-half condition means; group-centered fixed ridge on input summaries
interpretation: positive delta_R2 is descriptive held-TRAIN cost regression only, not Top1, regret, model gain, causality or representation collision
feature_contract: summaries(problem, raw) receives only raw coordinates/demands/L or matrix; no costs, winners, source indices or metadata

witness.selection: closest edge-marginal pair within same condition, input-only

tasks.source_identity_check: stat size/mtime matches cached source identities; no full dataset hash
